name: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 2
_note: Save-based from issue #54 (17 JKSV backups, v1.4, Unreal 5.4.1 save). Chap2Checkpoint/Checkpoint goes 1-7, 13, 14, 18, 24, 30, 32, 34, 35, 36 across the reporter's labelled backups (story names below follow those labels). TrophyDataWrapper lists the 9 collectible trophies in a fixed order (Barry, Bunzo, Claw, Daisy, GreenHand, Kissy, Mommy, PJ, Train) with a Collected bool each; names and descriptions are the official Steam ones. HasNoWrongAnswers appears after Musical Memory (false for the reporter, who made errors): mapped to Memory Master, not seen true yet. Game files (v1.4 Switch build, blueprints) list 32 achievement ids; Undefeated and Escape fire in the final train sequence, after the last save (Checkpoint 36), so the end is only ever seen as Checkpoint 36. HasDied appears once the player dies and stays true; SpeedrunTime is in seconds and Ahead of Schedule compares it with 2700 (45 minutes). Both are read at the last save (Checkpoint 36 plus 'requires': HasDied not true / SpeedrunTime < 2700); the time there is a little below the real finish time. The save class also has 'Watched VHS' (Avid Listener, all tapes) and inventory items, absent from these saves (no tape watched); documents, cutouts and the other event achievements are not saved.
